messages.text: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a formal definition of “eye diagram,” but they treat it as a high-speed signal-integrity measurement/analysis item, with “eye opening” quantified by eye height and eye width in PCIe Gen3–Gen5 post-equalization requirements.[1][5] Understanding it affects product-related decisions such as whether to include an eye-diagram-capable ZNA option, how to perform PCB material/stackup selection, and whether PCIe redriver output meets required eye-opening limits.[5][10][21]
### What the passages support about eye diagram
Eye diagram appears in the “Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA” together with insertion loss, crosstalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation.[1][2]  
For PCIe Gen3–Gen5, the passages specify eye-opening requirements as extrapolated eye height after equalization and minimum eye width after equalization, and state that minimum eye width and eye height are measured post-equalization before 3-tap DFE blocks.[5]  
The PCIe Gen5 layout passage also states that intra-pair skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver.[43]  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision area | What depends on eye-diagram understanding | Supported product / measurement fact |
|---|---|---|
| Instrument option selection | Deciding whether eye-diagram capability is needed on an R&S ZNA configuration depends on knowing that eye diagram is part of the required analysis. | R&S®ZNA-K20 is “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram)” and requires R&S®ZNA-K2, which is “Time domain analysis (TDR).”[21] |
| PCB fabricator / system-house workflow | Material/stackup selection can include Eye diagram alongside IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling. | R&S PCB test solutions list “Material/Stackup selection” with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram.[10][11] |
| PCIe redriver output validation | Pass/fail-style assessment of PCIe redriver output depends on comparing eye opening against generation-specific eye height and eye width values. | The PCIe passage states that PCIe redriver output eye opening needs to be greater than or equal to the listed eye-opening values for Gen3, Gen4, and Gen5.[5] |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | Eye diagram is one of the named SI-flow items, so deciding what SI measurements to include requires recognizing it as part of the flow. | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator.[2][7] |
| Interconnect/cable product evaluation limits | Some product pages cannot support eye-diagram-based validation because the cited sources explicitly lack eye diagram or PAM4 eye diagram data. | Direct Attached Copper Cables sources do not provide cable length, gauge, BER, eye diagram, active/passive boundary, power, compliance certificate, order number, or customer evidence.[14] |
| Connector product evaluation limits | Some connector claims cannot be converted into eye-diagram compliance claims because the cited source lacks PAM4 eye diagram, BER, compliance, and test-condition data. | The Celerity 224 Gb/s BGA mezzanine connector source lacks test conditions, PAM4 eye diagram, BER, compliance, and datasheet version.[17] |
### 【推論】
【推論】If a customer’s task is PCB material/stackup selection or PCIe redriver output validation, eye-diagram knowledge is needed before choosing or quoting an eye-diagram-capable measurement setup such as R&S®ZNA-K20, because the workflow names Eye diagram and the option explicitly includes eye diagram.[10][21]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › 文件脈絡
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）是 [[Texas Instruments]] application note《High-Speed PCB Layout for PCIe Gen 5》，文件編號 SNLA426，作者 [[Vicente Flores Prado]]。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）目標是協助熟悉 [[PCB manufacturing]]、[[PCB layout]] 與 design 的人員，在設計 high-speed [[PCI Express]] 平台時理解 PCB layout best practices 與 layout options。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] 資料傳輸速率為 32 GT/s；Gen5 x16 lane 設計需要以最佳化 [[crosstalk]]、[[return loss]]、[[insertion loss]] 為核心。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › 未決事項
- [[PCI Express Base Specification Revision 5.0]] 的正式版本、章節與發布組織頁尚未建立。
- [[CXL 2.0]] 與 [[TI DS320PR1601]] data sheet 需另以正式 datasheet 補證。
- `Roger` 是否應修正為 Rogers 或特定 laminate product family 仍需回查原文。
- Megtron 6、GETEK、Nelco 4000-6、FR4、Tetra Functional FR4 的材料規格與 datasheet 未納入。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCIe Gen3 到 Gen5 loss budget
| Generation | CPU Package | System Board Trace | CEM Connector | 4” Add-In-Card | Total System Loss | Cross Talk Mitigation | Temp/Humidity Loss | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 3.5 dB | 13 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 6.5 dB | 23.5 dB | Negligible | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 5 dB | 14 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 8.5 dB | 28 dB | <2 dB | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 9.0 dB | 16 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 1.5 dB | 9.5 dB | 36 dB | 4–5 dB | 2–3 dB | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] crosstalk 需要被緩解，且需要納入 total channel loss 考量；Gen5 至少需要比 total system loss 增加 4–5 dB signal strength，以改善 signal-to-noise ratio 並改善目標 BER 1E-12。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Suggested PCB stack-ups
[[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 PCB 至少 6 layers，並列出 DS320PR1601EVM、Alternate 8-LAYER、Alternate 10-LAYER stack-up examples。來源摘要提供的 [[TI DS320PR1601 EVM]] stack-up 為：

1. High speed signal
2. Ground
3. Low speed signal
4. Power
5. Power
6. Low speed signal
7. Ground
8. High speed signal

[[snla426]]（June 2023）也指出 directly adjacent signal layers 應以 90° offset routing，且 adjacent planes 上的 traces 不應跨越 splits。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a formal definition of “eye diagram,” but they treat it as a high-speed signal-integrity measurement/analysis item, with “eye opening” quantified by eye height and eye width in PCIe Gen3–Gen5 post-equalization requirements.[1][5] Understanding it affects product-related decisions such as whether to include an eye-diagram-capable ZNA option, how to perform PCB material/stackup selection, and whether PCIe redriver output meets required eye-opening limits.[5][10][21]
### What the passages support about eye diagram
Eye diagram appears in the “Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA” together with insertion loss, crosstalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation.[1][2]  
For PCIe Gen3–Gen5, the passages specify eye-opening requirements as extrapolated eye height after equalization and minimum eye width after equalization, and state that minimum eye width and eye height are measured post-equalization before 3-tap DFE blocks.[5]  
The PCIe Gen5 layout passage also states that intra-pair skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver.[43]  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision area | What depends on eye-diagram understanding | Supported product / measurement fact |
|---|---|---|

【推論】If a customer’s task is PCB material/stackup selection or PCIe redriver output validation, eye-diagram knowledge is needed before choosing or quoting an eye-diagram-capable measurement setup such as R&S®ZNA-K20, because the workflow names Eye diagram and the option explicitly includes eye diagram.[10][21]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。
